label: Кто
description: Five short drills for asking about people and identities.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Presence question. 1. 'Кто' asks for a person. 2. 'Здесь' keeps the location immediate. 3. The line is short and very reusable.
Strategic focus: Identification. 1. 'Кто' asks for identity. 2. 'Это' points to the referent. 3. This is the basic Russian identity question.
Strategic focus: Past event. 1. 'Кто' asks about a person. 2. 'Пришел' gives a clear completed action. 3. 'Домой' keeps the scene practical.
Strategic focus: Waiting frame. 1. 'Кто' pulls the subject slot open. 2. 'Ждет нас' gives a concrete interaction. 3. The sentence is easy to imagine in real life.
Strategic focus: Source of information. 1. 'Кто' asks who said something. 2. 'Сказал' anchors the sentence in speech. 3. 'Это' is the thing being referred to.

label: Что
description: Five short drills for asking about objects, facts, and meanings.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Object identity. 1. 'Что' asks for a thing or concept. 2. 'Это' points at the target. 3. This is one of the most important Russian questions.
Strategic focus: Perception. 1. 'Что' asks about the object of seeing. 2. 'Ты видишь' keeps the frame personal. 3. The sentence is direct and useful.
Strategic focus: Object location. 1. 'Что' asks for an unknown item. 2. 'Лежит на столе' gives the spatial frame. 3. This is a practical household question.
Strategic focus: Past action. 1. 'Что' asks for the purchased item. 2. 'Он купил' gives the event. 3. This is a clean everyday question.
Strategic focus: Need and planning. 1. 'Что' asks for the required thing. 2. 'Нам нужно' is a high-value practical pattern. 3. The sentence is useful for shopping and planning.

label: Где
description: Five short drills for asking about place and location.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Basic location question. 1. 'Где' asks for place. 2. 'Ты' keeps the sentence immediate and personal. 3. This is the shortest useful Russian location query.
Strategic focus: Missing object. 1. 'Где' asks where something is. 2. 'Моя книга' makes the target concrete. 3. This is a very natural everyday question.
Strategic focus: Meeting point. 1. 'Где' asks for a place. 2. 'Мы встретимся' gives the future action. 3. The sentence is perfect for arranging plans.
Strategic focus: Residence location. 1. 'Где' asks about location. 2. 'Твой дом' keeps the target simple. 3. This is a high-value real-world question.
Strategic focus: Environment question. 1. 'Где' asks for the location of the weather. 2. 'Идет дождь' is a standard weather frame. 3. The line is useful in travel and conversation.

label: Когда
description: Five short drills for asking about time and timing.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Planning time. 1. 'Когда' asks for timing. 2. 'Мы начнем' is a practical future action. 3. This is a very common coordination question.
Strategic focus: Arrival time. 1. 'Когда' asks for time. 2. 'Ты придешь' gives a clear future event. 3. The sentence is natural and conversational.
Strategic focus: Scheduled event. 1. 'Когда' introduces timing. 2. 'Будет ужин' keeps the sentence simple and concrete. 3. This is useful in daily household speech.
Strategic focus: Transit timing. 1. 'Когда' asks for departure time. 2. 'Поезд уходит' gives the event. 3. The sentence is excellent for travel practice.
Strategic focus: Readiness time. 1. 'Когда' asks for completion point. 2. 'Все готово' marks readiness. 3. This is a very useful planning and cooking line.

label: Почему
description: Five short drills for asking about causes, reasons, and motives.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Reason question. 1. 'Почему' asks for cause or explanation. 2. 'Он молчит' gives a common situation. 3. The sentence feels natural in real conversation.
Strategic focus: Departure reason. 1. 'Почему' asks for the reason. 2. 'Ты ушел' keeps the event clear. 3. This is a classic conversation repair question.
Strategic focus: State explanation. 1. 'Почему' asks about a condition. 2. 'Дверь открыта' gives the thing to explain. 3. This is a useful household question.
Strategic focus: Group delay. 1. 'Почему' asks for the reason. 2. 'Мы ждем' gives the shared action. 3. The line is short and useful for planning.
Strategic focus: Importance question. 1. 'Почему' asks for explanation. 2. 'Это важно' frames the issue. 3. This is a great sentence for discussion and argument.

label: Как

Strategic focus: Manner of speaking. 1. 'Как' asks about style or method. 2. 'Ты говоришь' keeps the verb simple. 3. This is useful for pronunciation and register talk.
